_comment: Points system used by derive.compute_standings_from_results for the independent standings computation described in docs/SPEC.md M2. This is what the cross-check against Jolpica-F1's own standings endpoint exists to catch drift on: if the FIA changes the points table for 2026 and this file is stale, cross_check_standings() will flag every round as a mismatch instead of silently producing a wrong table.
source: Unchanged since 2019 Sporting Regulations through the 2025 season (last version known at authoring time); NOT verified against the 2026 Sporting Regulations because this environment has no network access to the FIA's published documents. Treat 'verified: false' as a standing instruction to re-check this file against the actual 2026 regulations before trusting it, even though the automatic cross-check is the real safety net.
